openFindings.title: A test fixture still names the overlay folder barter-overlays
Barter OpenCode plugin tests stub the upstream bridge, so they cannot catch the bridge rename that disabled both plugins
Barter's three hooks hard-code the overlays folder name instead of reading .skilled-overlays.json
layoutMoves JSDoc still describes the old dot-dropped layout
No test covers the pre-commit git hook overlay lookup or its skip branch
Relayout leaves a half-moved overlay folder when a rename or the manifest write fails after the first move
The commit gate silently skips every overlay check when the overlay folder is not found
The doctor overlay presentation asset documents only one of the two LAYOUT remedies the engine emits
The LAYOUT overflow line advises apply --relayout even when the entries it counts are ones relayout refuses
The overlay-folder-outside-the-tree test is recomputed in four command paths instead of living on the context
The phase 002 spec's adoptSource evidence pointers no longer resolve, and its caller count is stale
The sibling check also accepts ../.git and other non-overlay siblings
The strict-write refusal tells an operator to create a copy for a path the overlay removes, and apply never installs it
Two 005 acceptance rows are marked Met while their cells record a deviation from the Then clause
writeBackup folds two backup areas into one nested loop written on a single line
